prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval grounded RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Coarse square pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, restrained 3-tone stone timber wool iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painted surfaces or photorealism. No people, no text or labels, no quest UI, no magic, no outcome animation. Daylight. Room/prop geometry is a proposal, not certified collision, official geography, inventory or narrative outcome. Open ordinary return path remains visually distinct. One modest wool-weaving trial room at night, with a small shielded oil lamp and a closed high side window, no nighttime prison feeling: wide unlocked open ordinary exit visible in foreground. ONE plain medieval wooden loom, modest incomplete length of muted undyed wool on beam. Adjacent low comparison bench holds TWO different small shuttle-join sample swatches, each separate, plus one partially rolled unfinished length. Modest tool peg board and empty stool, no stockpiled garments. No fairy magic, completed apprenticeship, debt cancellation, ownership brand or departure forced. Focus shuttle comparison and finite unfinished order; not a duplicate of a departure-baggage room.
